decisions.reason: As a close extension of the firm's secure communication platform that has already received dedicated market exposure since 2023, management would likely continue it because prior development and public commitment favor persistence and there is no clear evidence of failure.

Because the email-to-SMS gateway fits directly with the firm's announced strategy of integrated enterprise communication and has been launched under its own page, management would be inclined to keep backing it rather than reverse a fresh and visible commitment.

Since the SMS-to-email gateway is closely related to the core offer, supports the broader cloud communications direction, and has only recently been introduced with visible positioning, management would likely retain it and attribute any early weakness to normal ramp-up effects.
